description: A status board section in Svelte 5: a full-width tinted band with a heading, an SvBadge for overall health and a bordered, table-like grid of six cells. Each cell has a value, a label, a status dot and the change since an hour ago, colored by whether lower or higher is better. An SvSwitchButton turns on live updates that poll every 3 seconds, and the three columns become one on phones.

faq.question: How are the cell borders drawn?
faq.answer: The board is a CSS grid with a 1px gap on a background in the border color, and each cell has the page background. The gaps show through as the inner rules, and one outer border with a rounded corner frames the grid.

faq.question: How do live updates work, and how do I point them at real data?
faq.answer: The switch sets the core's live flag. An $effect inside the core starts a 3 second setInterval while live is true and clears it when it turns off or the block unmounts. Pass a poll option that fetches your metrics endpoint and returns the new cells; the default nudges the sample values.

faq.question: How does the health badge decide what to show?
faq.answer: Cells can set warnAbove. Any cell whose value is over its threshold gets an amber dot and a hidden '(above threshold)' note, and the badge counts those cells; with none it reads All metrics normal.
